original_objective: Complete the remaining Phase 2 gate measurements and subsequent FoveaTag work.
owner_requested_extension: Pause the current experiment, integrate run monitoring and SigLIP2 training-option coverage, verify it through the frontend, then resume the same run.
scope: Preserve the accepted Phase 2 artifact and the complete downstream Phase 3/4/5 objectives.
Register the existing A/B/C experiment in the normal training-run catalog without fabricating a SigLIP2 run.
Display branch, epoch, step, progress, loss, validation precision/recall/F1, learning rate and checkpoint/resume state.
Connect start/resume/stop to checkpointed lifecycle controls and enforce GPU ownership and duplicate-run guards.
Audit every TAGGER_TRAINING_DEFAULTS and request/UI option: shared, architecture-specific, implemented, or remaining; no silent option dropping.
Implement applicable optimizer, loss, learning-rate groups, precision, attention and checkpointing controls.
Implement applicable dataset, vocabulary, masking, online collection, vocabulary growth, detailed metrics, retention, sample and export integrations.
Keep pretrained SigLIP2 initialization options out of the scratch FoveaTag default and explain incompatible architecture-specific options.
Preserve the registered A/B/C input/data/optimizer budget when resuming the current experiment; new optional controls must not change its contract.
Update API defaults, OpenAPI, request types and UI together; test backend compilation, real imports and lifecycle contracts; review frontend statically.
Deploy only task-scoped changes to the running checkout, use only the backend restart endpoint if needed, then verify real API and frontend operation.
Resume the paused experiment only after the requested integration is verified.

pause.note: The legacy detached CLI lacks an external graceful-stop control. Its verified checkpoint is retained; unsaved subsequent steps will be replayed on resume.

goal_update: Owner-requested run/UI/option integration and the original remaining Phase 3/4/5 work are now recorded in the active goal.

shared_trainer_adapter.data: Native overview/local tensors and source geometry can use the shared dataset and online-buffer collator without NaFlex encoding.
shared_trainer_adapter.model: Full and attention-linear LoRA protocols support forward, head growth and exact self-contained unmerged weight roundtrips. No SigLIP2 weights are used.
shared_trainer_adapter.verification: 101 focused CPU tests pass, with eight explicit GPU checks skipped in that invocation. A separate opt-in run passes all 12 FlashAttention tests, including six actual GPU FP16/BF16 dense and shifted/padded forward/backward comparisons and two actual GPU checkpointed encoder comparisons. CPU common-loop full and LoRA stop/resume runs retain bit-identical final weights. Separate compile and real-import checks pass without initializing CUDA. These checks do not establish end-to-end speedups, native public API coverage, UI deployment or resumption of the existing comparison.

attention.owner_request: Support external FlashAttention, not only PyTorch SDPA flash kernels.
attention.implementation: The native shared factory maps use_flash_attention to external dense and packed-varlen kernels through the repository attention conduit. Packing separates shifted-window connected regions and preserves padding singleton attention. Shape/device plans are bounded-cached without per-step GPU-to-CPU mask synchronization.
attention.failure_policy: Explicit selection requires importable flash-attn. CPU/FP32/unsupported head dimensions use SDPA. External kernel failure is fatal. Disabled excludes external and PyTorch flash kernels.
attention.numerics: FP16 padding exposed an RMSNorm gradient NaN. Native optimized execution now uses FP32 normalization statistics; the frozen A/B/C eager runner remains unchanged.
attention.remaining: Native public API/UI selector, end-to-end measurements and deployment remain pending.

replay.offline: Native sampling uses an owned per-epoch generator; views use source index, epoch and seed. Resume records completed source batches separately from mixed-loader events and restores exact scheduler/scaler plus latest RNG state.
replay.online: Source cursor and injection cadence are restored separately, including an injection pending at the stop boundary. Live network arrivals and prefetched online samples are not claimed to be bit-reproducible.
replay.gpu_pause: Both the comparison and native shared trainer wait for generation's GPU release before restoring state and retain coordinator acknowledgements.
replay.bundle: Native resume commits bind required state plus only optional artifacts generated under current settings. Disabled stale sidecars are not published or restored; native vocabulary/metrics/OOD save failures propagate. Candidates are verified in descending step order with coherent retained-bundle fallback and no implicit scratch restart.
replay.remaining: Finish native option-specific, online/metrics integration, OOD reservoir's owned RNG continuity, API and frontend verification before public run creation.

exports.resume: The primary safetensors checkpoint always retains complete unmerged weights; shared optimizer and training-state files remain alongside it.
exports.inference: LoRA runs additionally write name_export.safetensors and metadata in compact or merged form according to checkpoint_save_mode. Compact exports require a scratch backbone with the recorded frozen-tensor fingerprint. Merged exports are self-contained for weights, with vocabulary referenced separately.
exports.retention: Expired step bundles remove both export files; latest and best_f1 remain outside step retention.
exports.ui_requirement: Explain compact/merged inference export versus full unmerged resume storage and expose the export path; do not label the primary resume file compact or merged.

remaining: Verify the complete native shared training loop, metrics, online data and optimizer resume contracts, not only the model/data protocols.
Finish online/metrics feature-specific verification. Keep the existing atomic A/B/C runner's resume contract separate and unchanged.
Finish visualization/inference and API/UI export integrations and measure attention end-to-end separately from correctness checks.
Synchronize API defaults, OpenAPI, request types and UI for native runs and audit remaining shared options.
Enable native run creation only after applicable options and their API/UI controls are complete; SigLIP2-only pooling dimensions must be explicitly refused.
Deploy, verify the real catalog and frontend, then resume the existing registered-budget comparison.

reporting_policy: Aggregate metrics only; do not display individual tag names or read generated diagnostic images.
